In [[44 ABY]], a '''second duel''' occurred in [[Kesla Vein]] on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], immediately after the [[First duel in Kesla Vein|first]]. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived near [[Kandra Nilitz]]'s [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]], they were again ambushed by several [[Sith Saber]]s of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], which were again commanded by [[Tola Annax]]. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], and outcast [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Vestara Khai]], fought the Sith. After the skirmish had come to an end, the Jedi took the landspeeder, in a hurry to find [[Abeloth]].
